title: microsorum pustulatum subsp. howense
intro: Microsorum pustulatum subsp. howense, commonly known as the Howes' fern or Howes' peacock fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is native to the subtropical regions of Australia and is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum pustulatum subsp. howense include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
